items.title: Chuck Mancuso interviewed by Monk Rowe, Buffalo, New York, October 10, 2013
items.q: Lawrence Welk. And Lawrence Welk, that’s when he had a little bit of a jazz group. And Bill played some jazzy stuff with him, you know.

ctx.x: Lawrence Welk. And Lawrence Welk, that’s when he had a little bit of a jazz group. And Bill played some jazzy stuff with him, you know. I don’t think he recorded. But, so when he did his studies, you know, he really started with hymnody, white hymnody, and shaped-notes singing, and spirituals and Gospels with blacks. And then he was big on folk music, you know, the Song Catchers and all that. This was a side I didn’t know about. So he would take me to Springville. I mean I’m a West Side kid you know. We’d go to…
Could you join in from even just a clapping your hands —
